title: Asset Allocation Heuristics across Risk Profiles
content: Optimal asset allocation balances risk tolerance with financial horizons. 1. Conservative Profile (Capital Preservation): 25% Equity, 55% Debt/Fixed Income, 10% Gold, 10% Tax-Saving. 2. Moderate Profile (Balanced Growth): 50% Equity, 30% Debt/Fixed Income, 10% Gold, 10% Tax-Saving. 3. Aggressive Profile (Maximum Growth): 70% Equity, 15% Debt/Fixed Income, 5% Gold, 10% Tax-Saving. Rebalancing annually aligns risk exposures with investor age and changing goals.
